scope: Read-only local archive and launch-contract audit; no remote check, training or optimizer
execution_plan: Two independent compute jobs, each gres=gpu:l40:1 and cpus-per-task=4, one arm per job, no distributed synchronization.
before_updates: Extract to fresh directory; no editing frozen sources
Verify archive, manifest and exact data SHA
Per-job CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and GPU UUID evidence
Real-data B32 CUDA K4/K8 forward/backward plus K32 forward, target_tail_frames=2; no optimizer updates
startup_acceptance: Both scheduler states RUNNING on distinct physical GPUs
Both history.jsonl steps progress with finite loss/gradient_norm, nonzero LR
Fresh run.json resume=null, matching data SHA/source hashes/validation_indices and intended config difference only
After checkpoint, Adam state exists and step consistent; frozen input_port unchanged; expected raw V additive bias may have no gradient
First scheduled validation at250 completes; failure of early learned-motion gate is a quality warning, not job failure
status_caveats: status.json is refreshed at step1 and validation checkpoints; use history tail for live progress
best.pt may be absent until full motion gates pass
At4000 final status=budget_completed and full_budget_completed=false is expected
CPU qualification in prepared bundle is not CUDA qualification
eta_method: Use recent step_seconds and observed validation_seconds. K1-1000 are K4, K1001-4000 are K8; never extrapolate all remaining steps from K4 alone. Concurrent wall time is max(arms), not sum.
